day.title: Stay in
day.tagline: Slow morning at the house, nap, no plans.
day.description: A day with zero agenda: sleep in, a long breakfast of khachapuri and strong coffee, a film and a nap while the snow does its thing. Perfect after a big night or a long drive.
highlights: Maybe a walk to the bakery
Pick it as often as you like

night.title: Stay in
night.tagline: Dinner and hangs at the house.
night.description: Sometimes the best night is the one where nobody has to go anywhere: order khinkali in, cook a pot of something, play cards and get a proper night's sleep before the next mountain.
highlights: Early night before a big day
Pick it as often as you like

activities.title: Old Tbilisi: Narikala by cable car & the bath-house domes
activities.tagline: Ride up to the fortress, wander down through 1,500 years.
activities.loved: Travellers rate the cable car over the Mtkvari as the best 2.5 lari in town, and the walk down — fortress walls, the hidden waterfall, carved wooden balconies — as the city at its most photogenic.
activities.description: Take the cable car from Rike Park up to Narikala fortress and the Mother of Georgia statue, then walk down through the old town: the brick domes of the sulfur-bath quarter, the waterfall in Leghvtakhevi gorge, the Bridge of Peace and the leaning clock tower. Short winter days suit it — the old town lights up early.
highlights: Bridge of Peace & the clock tower

sources.label: Eurasia Travel — Tbilisi aerial tramway (Rike Park → Narikala, 2.5 GEL)
Wander-Lush — Tbilisi in winter: 25 cold-weather things to do (2025–26 update)
Sakhva Travel — Tbilisi cable cars

activities.title: Private room at the sulfur baths
activities.tagline: Hot spring water under brick domes, a kisi scrub, zero plans.
activities.loved: The private rooms are what reviewers love most: your own steaming pool, a cold plunge and an attendant's kisi scrub that leaves you new — best split between friends, by the hour.
activities.description: Tbilisi was founded on these springs. In Abanotubani, book a private room (by the hour, for the group) at a bath house like Chreli Abano or the Orbeliani Baths: a hot sulfur pool, a cold plunge, a sauna and a scrub from an attendant. In December it's the warmest hour of the trip.
highlights: Your own hot pool & cold plunge
Split the room by the hour
activities.goodToKnow: Rooms are priced per room per hour (roughly 150–250 GEL for a big one), so the more of you, the cheaper. Book a day ahead around New Year.

activities.title: Chronicles of Georgia & a lakeside BBQ at the Tbilisi Sea
activities.tagline: Sixteen giant carved pillars above a reservoir — then mtsvadi on the grill.
activities.loved: Visitors are floored by the scale of the Chronicles — 30-metre pillars carved with Georgian history and Bible scenes — and how empty it is, twenty minutes from the city.
activities.description: Drive 20 minutes out to the Tbilisi Sea, the reservoir everyone calls a sea, and climb to the Chronicles of Georgia: sixteen bronze-and-stone pillars, each 30–35 m tall, telling the country's story. Then grab the rental cars' boot space for a lakeside barbecue of mtsvadi (Georgian skewers), lavash and pickles.
highlights: Easy first drive in the rental cars
activities.goodToKnow: It's windy and cold up on the hill in December — wrap up. Free to visit.

sources.label: Wander-Lush — Tbilisi in winter: 25 cold-weather things to do (2025–26 update)
Le Long Weekend — winter in Tbilisi guide

activities.title: Off-road buggies & karting by the Tbilisi Sea
activities.tagline: Mud, jumps and a 1000cc buggy, half an hour from town.
activities.loved: The buggy trails above the Tbilisi Sea get top marks for how fast it gets serious — a practice loop, then proper hills, ruts and views over the city.
activities.description: At the off-road park by the Tbilisi Sea you get a briefing and a practice lap on obstacles, then take 1000cc side-by-side buggies out on dirt trails and hills above the reservoir with a guide. Two to a buggy, helmets on, filthy by the end — a perfect group morning.
activities.goodToKnow: Priced per buggy and by group size; winter mud is part of the fun, so wear clothes you can lose.

sources.label: Lokalee — buggy driving around the Tbilisi Sea
Expedia — Tbilisi self-drive mountain off-road buggy

activities.title: Mtskheta & Jvari Monastery
activities.tagline: The ancient capital where two rivers meet, half an hour away.
activities.loved: People say the view from Jvari — two rivers of different colours meeting below a 6th-century church — is the moment Georgia clicks.
activities.description: Georgia's old capital and spiritual heart, a UNESCO site 30 minutes from Tbilisi. Drive the switchbacks up to 6th-century Jvari Monastery for the view over the rivers' confluence, then wander Svetitskhoveli Cathedral and Mtskheta's lanes of churchkhela stalls and tone-oven bakeries.

sources.label: Vagabond Journey — day trips from Tbilisi by car (Mtskheta, Ananuri drive times)
Georgian Holidays — Mtskheta, Jvari, Ananuri & Gudauri day (route & timings)
Sakhva Travel — Mtskheta-Mtianeti region guide

activities.title: Uplistsikhe cave town
activities.tagline: A 3,000-year-old city carved into the rock above the Mtkvari.
activities.loved: Visitors love scrambling between rock-cut halls, a theatre and a pharmacy older than Rome — and having it nearly to themselves in winter.
activities.description: An hour and a quarter west of Tbilisi, Uplistsikhe is a rock-cut town on a cliff above the river: halls, wine cellars and a basilica hewn from sandstone across 3,000 years. Pair it with Gori on the way back. Open year-round; the stone gets icy, so good shoes matter.

familyText.description: An hour and a quarter west of Tbilisi, Uplistsikhe is a rock-cut town on a cliff above the river: halls, storerooms and a basilica hewn from sandstone across 3,000 years. Pair it with Gori on the way back. Open year-round; the stone gets icy, so good shoes matter.

sources.label: Sakhva Travel — Uplistsikhe cave city
TripLinkHub — Uplistsikhe: open 10:00–18:00 year-round

activities.title: Ski or snowboard day in Gudauri
activities.tagline: Wide open pistes in the Caucasus, two and a half hours from Tbilisi.
activities.loved: Skiers love the wide, empty treeless runs, the views of the Caucasus from the top of Kudebi, and lift passes that cost a fraction of the Alps.
activities.description: Drive the Georgian Military Road to Gudauri (2,200–3,280 m) for a full day on the mountain: around 70 km of pistes, gondolas and chairlifts, and big open powder fields. Rent gear at the base, book a lesson if you're new, and stop at Ananuri on the way back while it's still light.
highlights: ~70 km of pistes up to 3,280 m
Gear rental & lessons at the base
activities.duration: Full day (~11 hrs door to door)
activities.goodToKnow: The 2025/26 season ran from about 27 Dec to 19 April; opening day depends on snow, so late-December dates aren't guaranteed. Winter tyres or chains for the drive; lifts run ~10:00–17:00.

sources.label: Wander-Lush — 18 things to know before you visit Gudauri (2025/26 season dates)
Skiresort.info — Gudauri: lifts, pistes and season dates
Loudavým krokem — skiing Gudauri & Bakuriani in 2026 (lift prices)

activities.title: Tandem paragliding over snowy Gudauri
activities.tagline: Take off from Kudebi and float over the Caucasus in the snow.
activities.loved: Flyers call it the highlight of their Georgia trip — 15 minutes of silence over white ridges, with the pilot filming the whole thing.
activities.description: Ride the gondola up Kudebi in Gudauri, clip in with a licensed tandem pilot and run off the mountain: 15–20 minutes over the snowy valleys of the Caucasus, landing near the resort. No experience needed. Make a day of it with the Ananuri fortress and the Zhinvali reservoir on the way.
activities.duration: Full day (~10 hrs door to door)
activities.goodToKnow: Weather decides: flights are cancelled in high wind or cloud, so keep a flexible slot. Add the gondola ticket if your package doesn't include it.

activities.title: Kazbegi & Gergeti Trinity Church
activities.tagline: Georgia's postcard: a lone church under 5,047-metre Kazbek.
activities.loved: Everyone who makes it up says the same thing — the photos don't do it justice: a 14th-century church on a ridge, snow everywhere, Kazbek glowing behind it.
activities.description: Follow the Georgian Military Road past Ananuri and over the Jvari Pass to Stepantsminda, then take a local 4x4 up to Gergeti Trinity Church (2,170 m) beneath Mount Kazbek. Lunch on khinkali in town and drive back before dark. The road is kept open in winter but can close for a day after heavy snow.
activities.duration: Full day (~11 hrs door to door)
activities.goodToKnow: Check the Jvari Pass the morning of: it shuts after heavy snowfall. Winter tyres are required Nov–March; the last climb to the church is 4x4 only (~50–80 GEL a jeep).

sources.label: Loudavým krokem — Kazbegi: 18 things to see (2026)
Sakhva Travel — things to see in Kazbegi
Georgian Holidays — winter in Kazbegi (winter tyres Nov–Mar, 4x4 to Gergeti)

activities.title: Sighnaghi & Bodbe Monastery, Kakheti
activities.tagline: A walled hill town over the Alazani valley, with the Caucasus behind.
activities.loved: Visitors love Sighnaghi's 18th-century walls and balconies, the view across the Alazani valley to snowy peaks, and how peaceful it is out of season.
activities.description: Cross the Gombori Pass into Kakheti, Georgia's wine country, to Sighnaghi — a hilltop town ringed by 18th-century walls with views across the Alazani valley to the snow-capped Caucasus. Walk the walls, visit Bodbe Monastery 2 km away, and stop at a family marani for a tasting and a long lunch.
activities.duration: Full day (~9 hrs door to door)
activities.goodToKnow: Heavy snow on the Gombori Pass can mean taking the longer road round; the walls have steep, uneven steps.

familyText.description: Cross the Gombori Pass into Kakheti to Sighnaghi — a hilltop town ringed by 18th-century walls with views across the Alazani valley to the snow-capped Caucasus. Walk the walls, visit Bodbe Monastery 2 km away, and stop for a long Kakhetian lunch of mtsvadi, shoti bread and churchkhela.

sources.label: Sakhva Travel — Sighnaghi day trip from Tbilisi (winter booking & Gombori Pass)
Eurasia Travel — Kakheti winter tale tour

activities.title: Martvili Canyon by boat
activities.tagline: Turquoise water between mossy limestone walls — big day trip west.
activities.loved: Visitors call the boat ride the most beautiful 20 minutes in Georgia: emerald water, waterfalls and dripping ferns, and it's one of the few canyons still open in winter.
activities.description: A long drive west (about 280 km) to Samegrelo for Martvili Canyon: walk the paths above the gorge, then take the inflatable boat through the narrowest, most turquoise stretch. It stays open in winter when other canyons close. A big day — leave early and share the driving.
highlights: Boat ride through the gorge (~20 min)
Big day trip · ~4.5 hrs each way
activities.duration: Full day (~13–14 hrs door to door)
activities.goodToKnow: Winter hours are about 10:00–18:00; boats can pause after heavy rain. Entry ~20–25 GEL plus ~20 GEL for the boat. Best as one day of a two-day trip west.

sources.label: National Parks of Georgia — Martvili Canyon (winter hours)
Wander-Lush — visiting Martvili Canyon: tips, boats and prices
Agency of Protected Areas — Martvili Canyon services & tariffs

activities.title: Gomis Mta: above the clouds, by the campfire
activities.tagline: A 2,000-metre ridge village where the clouds sit below you.
activities.loved: People who make it up describe standing on a meadow above a sea of cloud with the Black Sea glinting in the distance — and nights round a fire under every star there is.
activities.description: Gomis Mta sits at 2,000 m in the Meskheti range of Guria, a village of wooden summer houses famous for its sea of clouds. In winter the last stretch is deep snow and 4x4 only, so it's best as part of a trip west with a night in a cabin and a campfire. The real adventure of the trip — and the furthest.
activities.goodToKnow: The Roads Department closes the road up after heavy snow — check the day before. 4x4 with chains only for the last stretch, or walk in with a local guide. Plan it as an overnight from Kutaisi or Martvili rather than a day from Tbilisi.

sources.label: Georgia.travel — Gomismta
Georgian Travel Guide — Gomismta (4x4 roads, reviews)
Frontnews — roads to Gomismta and Bakhmaro closed by heavy snow

activities.title: Tbilisi food crawl: khinkali, khachapuri & the bazaar
activities.tagline: Soup dumplings, cheese boats and churchkhela, stall by stall.
activities.loved: Food lovers single out Dezerter Bazaar's spice and cheese halls and their first proper khinkali — slurp, don't spill — as the best way into the city.
activities.description: Start at the Dezerter Bazaar among spices, cheeses and hanging churchkhela, then work through the classics: khinkali dumplings, molten Adjarian khachapuri with an egg on top, lobiani bean bread straight from a tone oven, and pkhali. Finish with tea and pastries in Sololaki.

sources.label: Wander-Lush — Tbilisi in winter: 25 cold-weather things to do (2025–26 update)
Georgia.to — 15 things to do in Tbilisi this Christmas

activities.title: Khinkali & khachapuri cooking class
activities.tagline: Learn the 19 pleats, then eat everything you made.
activities.loved: Cooking-class reviewers love the chaos of everyone's first khinkali and the long table at the end — the closest thing to being adopted by a Georgian family.
activities.description: In a small group with a local host, knead and pleat your own khinkali (the goal is 19 folds), bake Imeretian khachapuri and learn the stories behind them — then sit down to eat the lot as a proper Georgian feast with toasts.

sources.label: byFood — small-group khinkali & khachapuri class in Tbilisi
Georgia.to — Georgian cooking with a local family

activities.title: Dry Bridge flea market & Fabrika
activities.tagline: Soviet badges, old cameras and enamel signs — then coffee in a former factory.
activities.loved: Browsers love the Dry Bridge market's oddities — medals, vinyl, cameras, antique horns — and bargaining in the cold with a hot coffee in hand.
activities.description: Hunt for treasures at the open-air Dry Bridge market (daily, busiest at weekends): Soviet memorabilia, vintage cameras, silver, vinyl and paintings. Cross the river to Fabrika, a Soviet sewing factory turned courtyard of cafés, shops and street art, for lunch.

sources.label: Eurasia Travel — the Dry Bridge flea market
Sakhva Travel — Fabrika Tbilisi: the courtyard, street art and people

activities.title: Funicular up Mtatsminda & the park on top
activities.tagline: The city's highest viewpoint, by a funicular from 1905.
activities.loved: Visitors say the funicular ride and the view from the top — the whole city in its valley, snowy mountains beyond — are worth it for the ponchiki doughnuts alone.
activities.description: Ride the 1905 funicular up to Mtatsminda, the hill above the city with its TV tower: a park with a Ferris wheel and rides, the best panorama in Tbilisi, and the Funicular restaurant famous for its ponchiki (cream doughnuts). Walk down via the Pantheon of writers and artists.

sources.label: Eurasia Travel — Tbilisi funicular to Mtatsminda
Sakhva Travel — Tbilisi cable cars

activities.title: Bassiani: techno under the stadium
activities.tagline: One of the world's great techno clubs, in a drained pool under the Dinamo Arena.
activities.loved: Ravers describe it as a pilgrimage: a concrete pool, a relentless sound system, no phones on the floor and a crowd that's there for the music until long after sunrise.
activities.description: Bassiani sits in a former swimming pool beneath the Dinamo Arena — a dark, cavernous room with a famously powerful system and international and Georgian DJs. Saturdays are the big nights; queues start around midnight, phone cameras get stickered and the door is selective.
activities.goodToKnow: Entry isn't guaranteed — check the line-up and registration on the club's site for your date, dress dark, arrive in small groups.

sources.label: Mixmag — Bassiani re-opened after forced closure
Sakhva Travel — Saturday in Tbilisi (Bassiani queues from midnight)
Resident Advisor — Bassiani events

activities.title: Left Bank: riverside club nights
activities.tagline: Two dancefloors and a courtyard on the Mtkvari embankment.
activities.loved: Clubbers like that it's looser than the big techno temples — house, electro and techno across two rooms, a courtyard to cool off, and a friendlier door.
activities.description: Left Bank on the Baratashvili embankment has two indoor dancefloors and an outdoor courtyard with its own DJ booth and bar, mixing Georgian and international DJs across house, techno and electro. Fridays and Saturdays are club nights; Thursdays and Sundays bring live shows.
highlights: Riverside, close to the old town
activities.goodToKnow: 18+. Thursday and Sunday are live nights rather than club nights.

sources.label: Techno Airlines — Left Bank Tbilisi (rooms, nights, door)
Mixmag — Left Bank's Space One becomes a café, bar and record shop

activities.title: Fabrika courtyard night
activities.tagline: A Soviet factory courtyard full of bars, street art and strangers.
activities.loved: People love that there's no door and no dress code — just a courtyard of bars under string lights where locals and travellers end up at the same table.
activities.description: Fabrika, a former sewing factory in Marjanishvili, is one big courtyard of bars, a cocktail cellar, pizza and street food under murals and string lights. No cover, no dress code — the night grows on its own, and it's an easy walk to the clubs after.

sources.label: Sakhva Travel — Fabrika Tbilisi: the courtyard, street art and people
Wander-Lush — Fabrika Tbilisi review
Sakhva Travel — Tbilisi nightlife guide

activities.title: Pub Golf through Old Tbilisi
activities.tagline: Six holes, one scorecard, golf caps compulsory.
activities.loved: Groups say it's the night everyone retells: a dress code, a scorecard and a route through the old town's cellar bars, wine bars and shot bars.
activities.description: Our own course through Sololaki and the old town: each bar is a hole with a par, you count your sips, and the lowest score at the 18th... well, the 6th, wins. Starts at Freedom Square, ends near the clubs. Commit to the outfits.
activities.goodToKnow: Venues change — re-check the course closer to the date.

rules.title: Pub Golf rules
items: Each bar is a hole. Par is the number of sips to finish your drink.
Count your sips; lowest total after six holes wins the green jacket.
Hole in one (finish in one sip): −1 bonus.
Soft drinks count — the score is sips, not units.
Water hazard: a glass of water at every hole, or take a +1.
Bunker: phone out at the bar = +1.
Dress code: golf caps, polos, plaid — commit to the bit.
Know your limit. Anyone can switch to softs and keep playing.

course.note: Group photo with the golden St George

sources.label: Wander-Lush — the best bars in Tbilisi
Sakhva Travel — Tbilisi nightlife guide

activities.title: Georgian supra feast with folk songs
activities.tagline: A table that never empties, a tamada and polyphonic singing.
activities.loved: Travellers say a supra is the real Georgia: dish after dish until there's no table left, toasts that turn into speeches, and singing that gives everyone goosebumps.
activities.description: Book a long table at a traditional restaurant with live polyphonic singing and folk dance: pkhali, badrijani, khachapuri, mtsvadi, khinkali and more keep arriving while a tamada (toastmaster) leads the toasts. The perfect group dinner after a big day out.
highlights: Dish after dish of Georgian classics
Long table for the whole group

sources.label: Georgia.to — Georgian cooking with a local family
Wander-Lush — Tbilisi in winter: 25 cold-weather things to do (2025–26 update)

activities.title: Dinner above the lights at Mtatsminda
activities.tagline: The whole city glittering below, and ponchiki for dessert.
activities.loved: Diners rate the view from the top of the funicular as the best in Tbilisi at night — the city spread out in its valley — and the cream doughnuts as non-negotiable.
activities.description: Ride the funicular up after dark to the restaurant at the top of Mtatsminda: Georgian and European plates by the windows, the city lit up below, and the famous ponchiki doughnuts downstairs. Ride back down or walk the lit path.

sources.label: Eurasia Travel — Tbilisi funicular to Mtatsminda
Wander-Lush — Tbilisi in winter: 25 cold-weather things to do (2025–26 update)

activities.title: Late-night sulfur bath
activities.tagline: Steam under the brick domes after a cold day out.
activities.loved: After skiing or a long drive, people say a late private room at the baths is the best thing they did — hot water, cold plunge, bed.
activities.description: Some Abanotubani bath houses run late into the night: book a private room for the group after dinner, alternate between the hot sulfur pool and the cold plunge, and walk home through the lit-up old town.
highlights: Old Town lights on the walk home
activities.goodToKnow: Late slots vary by bath house; book ahead over New Year.

sources.label: Big World Small Pockets — Tbilisi sulphur baths guide (Abanotubani & Orbeliani)
Travelness — Tbilisi sulfur baths: what they are and where to go

activities.title: The Nutcracker at Tbilisi Opera
activities.tagline: A New Year ballet in a Moorish-revival opera house.
activities.loved: Audiences love the gilded hall and tickets that cost a fraction of London or Paris — and the State Ballet of Georgia's Nutcracker is a holiday tradition.
activities.description: The Tbilisi Opera and Ballet Theatre on Rustaveli Avenue usually stages the Nutcracker over the New Year holidays (in 2024 it ran 21 Dec – 14 Jan). Dress up a little, sit in a gilded Moorish-revival hall, and walk Rustaveli's lights afterwards.
activities.goodToKnow: The programme is announced in the autumn — check tkt.ge for this season's dates before you count on it.

sources.label: 1TV — Tbilisi Opera presents the Nutcracker for the New Year holidays
Georgian Holidays — Tbilisi Opera and Ballet: Nutcracker magic
tkt.ge — Tbilisi Opera and Ballet Theatre tickets

activities.title: New Year markets & the lights of Rustaveli
activities.tagline: Mulled cider, churchkhela and a city wrapped in lights.
activities.loved: Visitors are charmed by how hard Tbilisi goes on lights — tunnels of them along Rustaveli, a giant tree, and markets selling gozinaki and hot treats.
activities.description: From mid-December the city fills with lights and markets: the main festive fair at First Republic Square, stalls at Fabrika and around the old town. Graze on gozinaki (honey-walnut brittle), churchkhela and hot snacks, then walk Rustaveli Avenue's light tunnels.

sources.label: Georgia Today — Tbilisi's Christmas markets and holiday festivities
Wanderlust — 9 festive experiences in Tbilisi
1TV — New Year celebrations at First Republic Square, 12 Dec – 7 Jan

activities.title: Natural wine cellars of Sololaki
activities.tagline: Amber qvevri wine, by the people who made it.
activities.loved: Wine lovers call Tbilisi's natural-wine bars the best in the world for the price — orange wine from clay qvevri, poured by the winemakers' friends.
activities.description: Georgia has made wine in buried clay qvevri for 8,000 years. Spend the evening between Sololaki's cellar wine bars — Vino Underground, the pioneer of natural wine in Tbilisi, and its neighbours — tasting amber and red qvevri wines with cheese and bread.

sources.label: Wander-Lush — the best bars in Tbilisi
Sakhva Travel — Tbilisi nightlife guide

activities.title: New Year's Eve countdown at Liberty Square
activities.tagline: The whole city lights the sky at midnight — be in the middle of it.
activities.loved: People who've done it say nothing prepares you: at midnight every balcony, roof and street in Tbilisi sets off fireworks at once, for what feels like an hour.
activities.description: Spend the evening around Liberty (Freedom) Square, under the golden St George and the giant tree, as the city's New Year concert plays nearby and the crowds build. At midnight Tbilisi erupts — fireworks from every hill and rooftop at once. Find a spot early and wrap up warm.
highlights: Fireworks from every rooftop at midnight
activities.goodToKnow: The city's main stage moves year to year (First Republic Square in 2025) — check the programme in December. Taxis are scarce after midnight: walk or plan your way home.

sources.label: Hotelier's Choice — Tbilisi New Year's Eve guide (Oct 2026)
Georgia.travel — New Year's Eve in Georgia
1TV — New Year celebrations at First Republic Square, 12 Dec – 7 Jan

activities.title: NYE feast, then fireworks from above
activities.tagline: A long Georgian New Year table, then the whole city's fireworks from a hill.
activities.loved: Locals spend New Year at the table: satsivi, gozinaki and a feast that runs past midnight — then the fireworks, best watched from up high.
activities.description: Do New Year the Georgian way: a long table at the house (or a restaurant) with the New Year classics — satsivi turkey in walnut sauce, gozinaki, khachapuri — then head up to a viewpoint near Mtatsminda or Narikala before midnight to watch the entire city light up below.

sources.label: Georgia.travel — New Year's Eve in Georgia
Hotelier's Choice — Tbilisi New Year's Eve guide (Oct 2026)

activities.title: Bowling
activities.tagline: Twelve lanes, a scoreboard and old rivalries.
activities.loved: A reliable group hour when it's freezing out — and the trash talk is free.
activities.description: East Point mall's entertainment floor has 12 lanes with a café; Lebowski bowling in the city is the other classic.

Georgian Travel Guide — East Point shopping & entertainment

activities.title: Go-karting
activities.tagline: Race the group on a proper outdoor track.
activities.loved: Karting Lilo became one of Tbilisi's busiest group activities soon after it opened — corporate tournaments and all.
activities.description: Karting Lilo near the airport has a ~1 km outdoor track; Rustavi International Motorpark, 20 km south, runs karting and track days too.
activities.goodToKnow: Outdoor tracks may close in snow or ice — call ahead.

sources.label: Georgia Today — Karting Lilo
In Your Pocket — Rustavi International Motorpark (karting & track days)

activities.title: Cable car to Narikala
activities.tagline: Two minutes over the river for 2.5 lari.
activities.loved: The cheapest great view in Tbilisi — even better after dark.
activities.description: The aerial tramway runs from Rike Park over the Mtkvari to Narikala fortress until late; pay with a Metromoney card.

sources.label: Eurasia Travel — Tbilisi aerial tramway (Rike Park → Narikala, 2.5 GEL)
Sakhva Travel — Tbilisi cable cars

activities.title: Snowmobile ride in Gudauri
activities.tagline: Full throttle across the snowfields.
activities.loved: The easy adrenaline hit for anyone not skiing — and great for photos.
activities.description: Snowmobile operators at the base of Gudauri run short rides and guided loops across the snowfields; two can share one.

sources.label: Out of Your Comfort Zone — the ultimate guide to skiing Gudauri (snowmobiles & more)
Sakhva Travel — Georgia in winter: Gudauri

activities.title: Ananuri fortress stop
activities.tagline: A fortress church on a turquoise reservoir, right on the road.
activities.loved: Everyone's favourite leg-stretch on the Military Road — towers, carvings and the Zhinvali reservoir below.
activities.description: The 17th-century Ananuri fortress, with two churches and a watchtower, sits on the Zhinvali reservoir about an hour from Tbilisi on the way to Gudauri.

sources.label: Vagabond Journey — day trips from Tbilisi by car (Mtskheta, Ananuri drive times)
Georgian Holidays — Mtskheta, Jvari, Ananuri & Gudauri day (route & timings)

activities.title: Adjarian khachapuri lunch
activities.tagline: A boat of bread, molten cheese, butter and an egg.
activities.loved: The dish everyone photographs — stir in the egg and butter, tear the crust, dip.
activities.description: Stop at a bakery or restaurant for Adjarian khachapuri: a boat-shaped bread filled with sulguni cheese, an egg yolk and butter.

sources.label: Wander-Lush — Tbilisi in winter: 25 cold-weather things to do (2025–26 update)
Georgia.to — 15 things to do in Tbilisi this Christmas

activities.title: Dezerter Bazaar wander
activities.tagline: Spices, cheeses and churchkhela by the kilo.
activities.loved: The partly covered halls stay warm in winter — the best people-watching in the city.
activities.description: Tbilisi's big central market: spices, sulguni, pickles, dried fruit and churchkhela, sold by vendors who love giving tastes.

sources.label: Wander-Lush — Tbilisi in winter: 25 cold-weather things to do (2025–26 update)
Eurasia Travel — the Dry Bridge flea market

activities.title: Old Town by night: lights, cable car & hot chocolate
activities.tagline: The old town glowing, from the riverbank to the fortress.
activities.loved: Visitors say Tbilisi is prettiest after dark — the fortress floodlit, the Bridge of Peace glowing and the bath-house domes steaming in the cold.
activities.description: Ride the cable car up to the floodlit Narikala fortress, walk down past the steaming bath-house domes and over the Bridge of Peace, and warm up with hot chocolate and pastries in the old town.
highlights: Cable car to the floodlit fortress

activities.title: Khachapuri golf: an Old Town food crawl
activities.tagline: Six stops, one scorecard, and a lot of cheese.
activities.loved: The same fun as a crawl — a course, a scorecard, silly hats — with khinkali-eating as the sport.
activities.description: Our own six-hole course through the old town, food-style: khinkali, khachapuri, lobiani, pkhali, churchkhela and ponchiki. Par is the number of bites; lowest score wins the green jacket. Golf caps encouraged.
